name: @dsh-remote/installer
description: Bootstrap CLI for installing dsh-remote-agent on an SSH host and starting its DSH Web host.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && DSH_REMOTE_CLI=1 DSH_REMOTE_HOST_ENTRY=src/bin.ts DSH_REMOTE_HOST_OUT=lib/cli.js node ../../scripts/build-host.mjs && node ../../scripts/build-host.mjs
